plan.goal: Verify the loan decision explanation is grounded in the real loan application and its eligibility assessment
checks: at least one decided (APPROVED or REJECTED) loan exists to explain
the eligibility assessment was retrieved with its checks
the AI explanation states the loan type and the requested dollar amount
the AI explanation names the eligibility checks that passed, and any that failed
plan.stop_condition: An explanation passes OBSERVE, or the retry budget is spent.

evidence.summary: 3 loans found but none decided. Create and decide one first: POST /api/loans then POST /api/loans/<id>/decision (APPROVE or REJECT).
